chapters.reason: The paper focuses on 'Knowledge Neurons' and how LLMs recall factual knowledge, which aligns with the role of shallow layers as representational processors for factual recall.
The study investigates how Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting influences factual recall and reasoning, which relates to the intermediate layers' role in forming latent CoT sub-circuits.
The paper analyzes the internal factual recall at each reasoning step, reflecting the micro-level observation of distinct computational roles across different layers.
